His net approval rating is also positive in several other states that make up the Republican heartland: In Indiana, Trump's net approval rating slipped underwater in Civiqs' polling in late June, after being positive throughout his second term. results.content: Amid President Donald Trump’s record-low approval ratings nationally, a new YouGov/Economist projection shows the president's net job approval is negative in all but three states. According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6). The lowest net job approval rating for Trump was in D.C. results.content: # Trump approval rating sinks to yet another low in new poll. President Donald Trump’s polling woes continue as he fell to a new record low since his return to the White House, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos survey, with only one in three Americans approving of his job performance. The poll, released on Aug. 17, found that only 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, down 2 percentage points from another Reuters/Ipsos poll from earlier this month. Trump’s performance on the Aug. 17 poll marks the lowest approval rating the president has seen in Reuters/Ipsos tracking since his return to the White House in 2025.
